query: What does your co-branded video work look like? Specifically joint pieces where two big brands share the spotlight without it turning into a logo soup.

props.title: Sharing the Spotlight Without the Logo Soup
props.subtitle: Co-branded video for two major brands
props.challengeSummary: You're asking how a joint video can give two big brands equal presence while still feeling like one story rather than a pile of logos.

props.caption: The co-branded Project Ceiba video we made for AWS and NVIDIA

props.title: Story First, Logos Second
props.content: In a joint piece, we'd build the film around the single idea both brands share, so the partnership shows up in the story itself and not in how the branding is divided.

props.title: AWS/NVIDIA: Co-Branded Video for a Visionary Collaboration
props.summary: We creative directed a co-branded video for AWS and NVIDIA's Project Ceiba AI supercomputer, from concept to execution. It blends interviews, use cases and custom 3D animations, and reached over 8 million combined views across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X and LinkedIn.

final.explanation: The AWS and NVIDIA film is our one published co-branded video, and we made it by working closely with both stakeholders to distill their collaboration into a single story. We haven't published other joint video work, so we can't point to a second example. For your project, we'd start by getting both brand teams in one room to agree on what the film is saying, before anyone discusses logo placement.
